market.worldSizeUSD_B_range: Global SMC (Sheet Moulding Compound) market: $1.1B (2024) to $1.8B by 2033 (6.2%/yr, 2026-2033). Global FRP Grating market: $625.4M (2024) to $956.7M by 2033 (4.8%/yr, 2025-2033) per one estimate, or $691.3M by 2025 (5.1%/yr, 2020-2025) per another. India's growing EV and renewable-energy sectors reportedly boosted SMC usage by 24%. No India-specific standalone $ market size was found.

market.domesticSlice: Sintex is a major established India brand in SMC junction boxes/electrical enclosures. FRP grating manufacturers Fibrograts, FRP Products India, Darshit Trading Company are named but appear small/private with no disclosed financials.

structureFacts: SMC's insulating, flame-retardant, mechanically robust properties are driving adoption in electrical enclosures, switchgear, and circuit breakers as utilities/industry modernize grid infrastructure
Growth drivers: renewable energy installation growth, smart grid infrastructure expansion, EV market growth, continued infrastructure/construction investment
BIS standards IS:13410 and IS:14772 govern SMC junction box specifications in India — a real domestic compliance bar

adoptionStructure.note: Utilities and industrial buyers value corrosion/weather resistance (vs. metal enclosures), fire-retardant/insulating properties for safety compliance, durability in harsh/offshore/corrosive environments, and increasingly BIS/export-standard (ASTM) certification for government tenders and export contracts.
